a: Contribution margin is revenue minus variable costs.
Fixed costs stay stable; variable costs scale with volume.
Payback period is time to recover an investment.
NPV discounts future cash flows to present value.
IRR is the discount rate that makes NPV zero.
Price elasticity measures demand response to price changes.
An economic moat is a durable competitive advantage.
Network effects increase value as more users join.
High switching costs make customers less likely to leave.
Average costs fall as production volume rises.
